title: A constructible subset meets an open subspace in a constructible subset
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space (for instance the underlying space of a scheme), let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subset with the subspace topology, and let $E\subseteq X$ be a constructible subset of $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Then $E\cap U$ is a constructible subset of the topological space $U$ (Stacks Topology, Lemma 005J).
